newsitem.title: USA: American Financial files for offering.
newsitem.headline: American Financial files for offering.

text.p: American Financial Group Inc said it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of four million trust originiated preferred securities at $25 each.

The securities will be issued by American Financial Capital Trust I, a Delaware statutory business trust controlled by American Financial, which will exist solely as a financing vehicle for the company.
The securities represent a preferred, undivided beneficial interest in the assets of the trust, the company said.
Merrill Lynch & Co is the lead manager of the underwriting group for the offering.
American Financial said Standard & Poor's has assigned an investment grade rating of triple B minus to the securities.

American Financial said it plans to use the net proceeds of the proposed offering to retire $50 million of outstanding debt of its subsidiaries and the remainder for general corporate purposes, which may include the retirement of additional fixed rate securities and investment in insurance businesses.
A registration statement has been filed with the SEC, but has not yet become effective, the company said.

American Financial also said Standard and Poor's Corp has raised all of the debt ratings of its primary subsidiaries, American Financial Corp, American Premier Underwriters Inc and American Annuity Group Inc.
American Financial Corp's senior debt securities received a triple B rating, up from triple B minus on about $165 million of debt securities.
American Premier Underwriters rating for about $250 million princial amount of subordinated debt was raised to triple B minus from double B plus.
The senior debt of American Annuity Group received a rating of triple B, up from triple B minus. American Annuity's subordinated debt was raised to triple B minus from double B plus.
American Annuity has about $25 million and $41 million respectively of senior and subordinated debt outstanding.
